Title: Cloud-based load testing features will be retired on March 31, 2020

Body.Content:
On March 31, 2020, we’ll retire cloud-based load testing in Microsoft Visual Studio and cloud-based load testing in Azure DevOps, the performance testing feature of App Service and Application Insights in the Azure portal.

To continue cloud-based load testing, choose from several of our Azure partners and alternatives that are well equipped to adapt to your unique performance testing needs.

Required action

Implement a new load testing solution by March 31, 2020, to continue performance testing as usual.

For cloud-based load testing, see our partners in the Azure Marketplace:

  • CloudTest Lite
  • Load Impact
  • Tricentis Flood
  • Micro Focus LoadRunner

Or consider these load testing tools outside the Azure Marketplace:

 

  • Apache JMeter open-source software
  • BlazeMeter

Learn more about this change on our blog.
